描述_ZN: Couplet in Four Words in Running Script, modern, inscribed by Xu Beihong, on paper, in running script, 128.8 cm in length and 31.2 cm in width.　　The upper couplet reads, "Ming shame teaches war. Mr. Huadu Huizheng." 　　The next couplet reads, "Many difficulties make a nation. At the age of 32, Beihong visited Guiyang."　　Inscription of "Xu Beihong" seal.　　Thirty-two years that refers to the Republic of 32 years (1943), Xu Beihong was 48 years old.　　In terms of calligraphy, Xu Beihong copied the calligraphy of Ni Yuanlu, Wang Duo, Fu Shan and others on the basis of copying the Northern Monument, gradually forming his own style of open bones, coherent brushwork, handsome brushwork, ancient and naive personal style.　　This couplet is a masterpiece of Xu's mature calligraphy. It is written with a mid-front stroke, with a rounded, square and clumsy style, showing the characteristics of Wei Bian calligraphy's outward and square brushwork, without losing the hard and stubborn style of Wang Duo and others of the Ming dynasty, and with a natural and natural interest in the flowing and handsome style. The content of the calligraphy expresses the author's enthusiasm for the war effort.
